components.name: nsis-tauri-utils
components.note: Official no_std DLL, SHA-256 5ba143b5db4a87d32d6e7802e033330aae56cbceabe0d1e3ba41948385ad4709. Upstream has no Cargo.lock; runtime semver 1.0 and windows-sys 0.61.2 dependency ranges are declared, not exact resolved versions. Their upstream license/copyright texts are also retained in the Cargo component entries. nsis-fn is a build-time macro.

components.name: nsis
components.displayName: NSIS installer, plugins, UI assets and compression modules
components.note: Unmodified NSIS 3.11. LZMA is used. The supplied COPYING also documents optional bzip2; inclusion does not assert that bzip2 is used. Complete source is available at the pinned source URL, including Source/7zip and build scripts. Linked Beetroot code is not relicensed under CPL.

components.license: MIT OR Apache-2.0; component exceptions retained below

components.note: Conservative complete standard-library attribution, including target-specific dependencies. Text extracted from the original COPYRIGHT-library.html shipped in Rust 1.89.0; not a claim every listed target-specific file is linked on Windows.
